exam: 110年公務人員高等考試三級考試暨普通考試
subject: 海事英文

essays.text:
請試述下列名詞之意涵：（可用中文或英文作答，每小題 5 分，共 30 分）
① Gross Tonnage
② Passenger Liners
③ Light Displacement
④ Traffic Separation Scheme
⑤ Propeller Cavitation
⑥ Dredging of Anchor

英譯中：（每小題 10 分，共 40 分）
① Coal is among the biggest commodities transported by the dry bulk shippingsector and European countries have already scaled back usage as they lookfor greener alternatives.
② In 2020, global coal shipments amounted to an estimated 1.25 billion tons,with major producers Indonesia and Australia accounting for 59% of theseseaborne exports. Global coal shipments were estimated at 1.38 billion tonsin 2019.
③ Maersk is calling on the International Maritime Organization — shipping’sglobal regulator — to have a carbon dioxide tax for the industry ready by2025, likely starting at about $50 a ton, then ramping up to at least $150 aton in subsequent years. While the company is not able to officially submitplans to the watchdog, its size and importance will color the upcominginternational discussions.
④ Japanese coast guard ships and aircraft were searching on Friday for threemissing crew of a cargo ship that capsized and sank after a collision with aMarshall Islands-registered tanker in the Seto Inland Sea, authorities said.

中譯英：（每小題 10 分，共 30 分）
①世界上最大的貨櫃船航運公司呼籲對航運燃料徵收每噸 150 美元的碳稅，這將推高一個占世界貿易 80%行業的成本。
②該船原定於高雄港 66 號碼頭靠泊，但當該船通過 70 號碼頭時，與停泊在 70 號碼頭的“永鴻船”（總噸位 32,720）船頭相撞，其中一艘船頭輕微受損。碼頭邊的 GC8 橋式起重機倒塌後，相鄰的 GC6 起重機受損嚴重，共發生倒塌 1 台，嚴重損壞但未倒塌 1 台，損壞 30-50 個貨櫃。
③雖然遠洋輪船已經是最環保的交通方式，船舶仍占全球二氧化碳排放量的近 3%。
